a.lede: Built directly into the YouTube Music app, Ask Music lets users describe what they want to hear in everyday language rather than searching for individual songs or artists.
a.title: YouTube Music gets more conversational with new AI features

b.lede: ouTube’s new custom feeds let users describe the videos they want to see in their own words, then use Gemini to build a personalized feed around the request.
b.title: YouTube will let you build your own algorithm with AI
